sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Stick Shadow Fighter Legacy is a platformer game where you control a stickman who must navigate through levels filled with obstacles, enemies, and hazards. The game's controls are simple, utilizing a mouse click to jump and move left or right. As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new mechanics, such as new enemies, obstacles, and power-ups that require precise timing and strategy to overcome. The game's level design is carefully crafted to provide a smooth learning curve, introducing new challenges and obstacles at a gradual pace.

One of the game's core mechanics is its use of procedurally generated levels. This means that each time you start a new game, you'll be presented with a unique set of levels, ensuring that no two playthroughs are the same. The game's level generator takes into account your skill level and progress, ensuring that the challenges become increasingly difficult as you progress.
